Width of a TALE alignment

Source: R/tales_msa_class.R
tales_width.Rd

The number of columns in the alignment, including those that are all gaps in the object at hand. Stored rather than derived: subsetting arrays can empty the last column, which would silently shrink max(alignment_position).

Usage

tales_width(x)

Arguments

x

A tales_msa object.

Value

An integer scalar, or NULL if unset.

See also

Other TALE alignment: as.matrix.tales_msa(), is_tales_msa(), tales_align(), tales_consensus(), tales_consensus_match(), tales_msa(), validate_tales_msa()
